Look, the overall idea is that DOT is in a bearish market, in a bear market. DOT is in a large correction. It is only moving up currently in three wave structures. Main examples here include the rally after the 24 low. Also here from the June 25 low, clearly a three wave move up. And then here, this was most recently also a three wave move up. The potential is that we are now in this fourth wave, which kind of in terms of the wave degree matches this wave too, which means the move to the upside is likely going to be a corrective bounce that could turn into something a bit larger, a bit more significant with resistance between 193 and 359. This is not needed, but could play out over the coming weeks as long as the market can hold the $1.16 level. Now again, this is not really bullish because until we actually see a small 1-2 set up to the upside in wave 4, this is a falling knife, okay? Look, we're in a downtrend. There isn't really anything here that would tell me really that we're going higher. It's simply based on the wave count that I can identify a completed C wave in wave three to the downside, which means that the next move up should be a fourth wave. It might have started, actually, yeah, and we can call this the initial A wave, this the B wave, and then the potential is that we're moving up in the C wave, and the C wave should ideally be a three-wave bounce that could play out, for example, here in this wave four, and the initial move up was a bit too small to be all of the fourth wave. Yeah, I mean, if you look at the proportions compared to the wave two which unfolded between august 24 and december 24 um this bounce started in february i mean one and a half months have have now you know kind of passed and yeah there is uh this is a multi-week let's say bounce range rather yeah it's rather a range but essentially to have um let's say similar proportions between waves two and four we would ideally see this c wave up now if it moves down lower would that change much no it would just probably mean that the third wave is simply extending in that case the next support levels are at 91 cents and then at 75.5 cents. And this here is currently a three up, three down move. And we could start a C wave to the upside from this region, which is between $1.16 and $1.31. I'm going to remove the upper section. But overall, nothing really unusual here at the moment this is a crystal clear three wave move down so far this might turn into something more bearish yeah but for now we have three Fibonacci levels here to watch where the market might react that's the update on DOT hope you like the update if you did please hit the like button leave a comment and subscribe and if you're interested in additional updates i recommend that you also check out our x channel for additional updates charts news and much more on x i'm currently uploading all the 2026 outlook updates for various cryptocurrencies so it gives you a good idea um into the forecast for q2 thanks so much wish you a great day bye
